subject.title: Feature: Processing indicator message for Telegram (send ⌛️ while thinking, delete on reply)

question: Should Telegram support a standalone processing message with delete/edit finalization, or should typing and status reactions remain the canonical presence model?
rationale: Both directions are technically viable but create different visible behavior, configuration, and failure semantics; current source and related work do not establish which contract maintainers intend to support.

options.title: Unify the presence contract
options.body: Compare this lifecycle with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/80690 and define one coherent Telegram config and behavior before implementation.

options.title: Add standalone placeholders
options.body: Keep typing and reactions intact while adding an explicitly opt-in message placeholder with success cleanup and failure editing.

options.title: Decline message placeholders
options.body: Treat typing and status reactions as the supported Telegram feedback mechanisms and close this request by product decision.

recommendation.title: Unify the presence contract
recommendation.body: Compare this lifecycle with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/80690 and define one coherent Telegram config and behavior before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership of Telegram status finalization and the existing review context make him the strongest available decision-routing candidate.
